chunks: From him, from Al-Jamourani, from Ibn Abi Hamza, from Saif, from Is-haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abi Baseer, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he forbade his son Ismail from keeping the ring-dove, and he said:
If you must keep one, then keep the Warshaan (wood-pigeon), for it frequently remembers Allah, Blessed and High.

key_terms.وَرَشَان: Wood-pigeon, a specific type of dove/pigeon

ai.seo_question: Why did the Imam prefer the wood-pigeon over the ring-dove?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) guides his son Ismail toward spiritual mindfulness by recommending the wood-pigeon (*Al-Warshaan*) over the ring-dove (*Al-Fakhta*) due to the former's constant vocalizations, which are interpreted as a form of dhikr. This reflects the Shia scholarly tradition of finding divine signs and spiritual lessons in the natural behaviors of animals, encouraging believers to cultivate a state of perpetual remembrance of Allah in daily life.
